notes.title: Good to see you, Detective! #devlog
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, Detective🕵️[/h2] 

Let's see what has changed here recently 👁️

[previewyoutube=OU3mAfH23ZE;full][/previewyoutube]

First and foremost, it's worth highlighting that we finally had the chance to meet in that shadowy alley and delve into the mystery surrounding the death of the android. For those intrepid detectives who remain eager for more thrills, remember that there's still an opportunity to sign up for the playtests!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/thnxaUG.gif[/img]
🩸A detective’s work isn’t just about scouring alleys and hidden corners; sometimes it involves delving into the very essence of the victim. Literally. In this technology-dominated world, blood can provide answers to many questions. And you'll be able to analyze it to uncover further clues.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/x9DHiIb.gif[/img]
🧹Cyberdust remains an enigmatic phenomenon. It settles on objects, concealing their true identities. To unearth valuable clues, you'll need to get your hands dirty. But never has it been so gratifying.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cHniaTT.gif[/img]
🧱Cyberdust doesn’t just settle on objects. You might encounter walls or other surfaces coated in it, often linked to human activity... or the actions of other beings.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bGaZPqa.gif[/img]
🔒Even if you know the code to a lock, it’s useless without proper authorization. In such cases, your only option is to hack it.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mlV2nt8.gif[/img]
⚡Sometimes you'll come across broken wires. It’s always worth connecting them - even if they don’t open anything, they might at least illuminate a few lights!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wFaC39l.gif[/img]
🤖Reconstruction is fundamental to a detective’s work. You need to transport the data sphere to the correct location to reconstruct it. The closer you get, the more the data will become turbulent. If you get really close, the data remnants will pinpoint the exact location for you.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Abndiqt.gif[/img]
💃🕺Dance hall. Why does it always lead to such places - beautiful, grand structures that merely mask the corruption and bitterness of those within? What will you uncover this time about the investigation... and human nature?

[url=https://discord.gg/rGTujB9Y74][img]https://i.imgur.com/w04sgfK.png[/img][/url]
Thank you for your tests, detectives. They have given us incredibly valuable feedback. We invite you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/rGTujB9Y74]Discord[/url], where you can not only report bugs but also share your ideas.

Let’s stay in touch!🤝

notes.title: Improvements in the investigation
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome, Detectives! 🕵️[/h2]

We are continuously testing the game and receiving amazing feedback from you, so we have made a few improvements and fixes to the playtest. We hope that the implemented fixes will make your experience better and more immersive.

[b]By the way, we're sending out more invitations for the playtest.[/b]

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*] The name of the clue will appear when you hover over it in the clues menu
[*] Fixed the issues with the loading screen freezing
[*] Fixed issues in the investigation – added the missing letter of the code and a hint for the puzzle (additional hint: look by the dog and follow the colors)
[*] Fixed the functionality of the sound options
[*] Answers to some questions have been slightly changed to better fit and be more consistent
[*] Added new effects for cleaning cyberdust from walls and floors
[*] Added a hint to the reconstruction – now, if the bullet is near the reconstruction area, a clue will appear to help locate it
[*] Added markers for interactions, making them easier to locate – they will appear after using the scanner
[/list]
[previewyoutube=ATFkiKzUpBo;full][/previewyoutube]
Additionally, it’s time for a small update on Steam! As our project has significantly developed recently, we’ve prepared a new, refreshed version of the trailer and screenshots that showcase the progress. We also wanted to show you more of the second location – The Dance Hall!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Izryiwv.jpeg[/img]

[b]Check it out on the main page![/b]

[h3]Thank you very much, testers![/h3]

Remember that you can submit feedback on our [url=discord.gg/rGTujB9Y74]Discord [/url]and through the dedicated [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScLRUJDnKrkf5zPT2pTlaNd8FlC3vR8l-no0OJLFZbTWS6LvQ/viewform]Playtest Feedback Form[/url] (it’s also available after completing the demo).

If you have any questions or suggestions, we are at your disposal on Discord or the Steam forum.

[b]Until next time, Detectives![/b]

notes.title: The hacker has been defeated!
notes.content:
[h1]Detective, detective! Access has been restored, you can return to the case![/h1]

[h2]Playtests should now be working, and everyone who received access should be able to play. Thank you for your patience![/h2]

[h3][b]Just to remind you what it's all about...[/b][/h3]

Finally, we're heading into the field! Let's meet in the alley and see what we're dealing with. Remember, keep me informed about everything.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JkWFUD2.png[/img]
[h3]The first playtest invites have been sent out! We warmly welcome you to check out our game—your feedback is crucial as we're making it for you![/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dnJH8xg.gif[/img]
In the playtest, you'll find improved cyberdust cleaning with new effects. What might be hidden beneath it? 👁️

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NlTJNac.gif[/img]
You'll also have the chance to perform a blood analysis. This vital substance can hide many secrets—especially if it belongs to the deceased. 🩸

Please remember, this is a very early version of the game. Not everything is final, and you might encounter bugs. We kindly ask you to report them, preferably on our Discord or through the form at the end of the level. Your feedback will be immensely helpful. 👇

[url=https://discord.gg/Np9kVmsSSV][img]https://i.imgur.com/w04sgfK.png[/img][/url]

Oh, and this is the first round. [b]If you didn’t manage to sign up, no worries - register on the site, and you'll have a chance to get access next time.[/b]

Thank you for your feedback and commitment!

We're in touch, Detective 🕵️

notes.title: Time to piece together the clues
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Detective.[/h2]
[previewyoutube=0uaZ8_dfHk4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Sometimes a new perspective on the case is needed[/h3]
Some things shift in the shadows, but the core remains unaltered. Adapt or vanish into the city's dark void.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SOmMsBZ.gif[/img]
To avoid getting lost in the twists of the case and the maze of mysteries, your [b]crime board[/b] is indispensable. Organize the clues to answer the key questions.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cmsZqU4.gif[/img]
[b]Blood [/b]reveals much about a person. Use this information to link events and places, and steer the investigation onto the right path.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/77XvfDn.gif[/img]
Nothing beats old-school detective methods... but [b]bullet's trajectory reconstruction[/b] is quite useful.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hHmKd4C.gif[/img]
Be careful when examining contaminated evidence. Hopefully, you won't come across too many [b]glitches[/b].

[h3]Don't forget to join our secret communication channel here[/h3]
[url=https://discord.gg/Qv4ZnGtM6J][img]https://i.imgur.com/X9Jg1Ao.png[/img][/url]

Recent changes have allowed us to make everything consistent and showcase the project's unique identity. Join us on Discord to share your ideas or ask questions - we're here for you!

Now the real game begins. Streets are haunted by tales of legendary techno-vampires, and the stakes could be higher than ever. 

Wanna take the case?

notes.title: What's in the box?
notes.content:
[h2]Another day, another changes in The City.[/h2]
Are you ready for new challenges, Detective?

[previewyoutube=CejLjp87Rps;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Join our dedicated [url=https://discord.gg/Qv4ZnGtM6J]Discord [/url], where you can talk about the game, share your ideas and chat with us - the devs![/h3]
[url=https://discord.gg/Qv4ZnGtM6J][img]https://i.ibb.co/9ZyG15b/CD-DC-Banner-2.png[/img][/url]

[h3]So, shall we take a look at what's new on the streets?[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/4UomsEy.gif[/img]
To get to the valuable clues, you'll have to face puzzles that will test your mind and your keen eye. You want to know what's in the box? 🧩

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tIgxdX6.gif[/img]
The scanner will uncover hidden pieces of the puzzle and offer a new perspective on certain things. It's up to you to use it and connect the dots 👣

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dvwPlEn.gif[/img]
Sometimes, a good informant is worth their weight in gold. But can anyone be more trustworthy than a good boy? 🐕

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dU01Np7.gif[/img]
Sometimes, it's good to just stop and soak in the street's atmosphere. Especially with those new lights around... 💡

If you've got any thoughts or ideas regarding our case, jot them down [url=https://discord.gg/Qv4ZnGtM6J]here[/url]. Let this be our secret communication channel.

Meanwhile, farewell, Detective 🕵️ Until next time 🤝
